info.title: Cerbero common envelope
info.summary: The response envelope and the closed error codes shared by every API between Cerbero components.
info.description: Each API between components answers with this envelope and these codes. The HTTP status of each code is fixed by the contract of each API: Hermes, for example, returns the failures of its providers inside the envelope.

ErrorCode.description: The closed set of error codes common to every API between components.

oneOf.description: The request does not follow its contract: not standard JSON, missing or extra fields, or a malformed value.
The credentials are not valid: a certificate, a short call token or an enrollment token.
What the request names does not exist.
The operation is not allowed in the current state, or an Idempotency-Key is reused with other content.
Too many attempts; retry after retry_after_s seconds.
An external provider behind the component is not available.
An external provider did not answer in time; outcome_unknown says whether the effect may have happened.
The component cannot serve now and it is worth retrying later, for example Hécate while sealed.
An unexpected failure; the message does not reveal its cause.

RequestId.description: The X-Request-Id of the request, from 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters, or one that the component generates.

Completed.description: A request that completed; each operation refines data.

Failed.description: A request that failed; each API fixes the HTTP status of each code.
